sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Butcher is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Have you heard the stories about the serial killer who was operating in the city? The first rumors about the "Tarkov Butcher" appeared during the Contract Wars. But because of the conflict, the investigation was abandoned. An acquaintance of mine has taken an interest in this case and is looking for traces left by the Butcher. To track him down, we need to understand his motives and what drove him. The documents we managed to recover from the police department state that the Butcher worked as a driver for one of the meat processing plants. The victims' bodies were discovered in refrigerated trucks used for transporting meat… If you can find anything that could help with the investigation, I would be grateful. And one more thing: my acquaintance requires certain medications. Deliver him a chemical container with everything he needs."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the chemical container on Ground Zero
- Stash the container by the police station on Streets of Tarkov

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Surv12 field surgical kit
"Your discovery will help us in our search for the killer. Thank you. Here is your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Container with suspicious substance | 1 | Required | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you first have to find a chemical container inside a truck trailer in the underground of Ground Zero. Afterwards it has to be stashed in front of the ministry of the interior academy on Streets of Tarkov.
